blocks.source: Vol IV, Safety Enforcement, § The Enforcement Record
blocks.md: When a warehouse mobile manipulator halts at a rack end because runtime safety logic rejected a motion proposal, forensic analysis requires unambiguous provenance: which threshold failed, which physical detector measured the violation, and which fallback rung took control of the actuators. The **enforcement record** is the tenth record in the record chain, the point where offline characterization meets online execution. It formalizes runtime safety across three cooperating artifacts:

questions.q: The section **The Enforcement Record** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Available deceleration is net of gravity and bias in the worst direction, and integrator unwinding and saturation spend it before the stop begins.

A series compliance, whose stiffness falls below that of its softer element because compliances add, slows the force rise and bounds impact force passively when the enforcer cannot stop in time, so its stiffness is part of the contact margin.

A least-change projection passes a safe proposal untouched and projects a violating one onto the barrier boundary, keeping learned competence, while a structurally invalid proposal is vetoed rather than corrected.

The enforcement record joins a signed enforcement contract (tracking bound, barrier coefficients, deadlines, effort-error bounds, routing) to a per-tick admitted command with its margin, detector, and rung.
